description: Build an electronic lab notebook (ELN) entry template for an experiment: objective, materials, procedure, observations and conclusion sections from a preset or custom list, optionally with timestamp fields and voice-capture prompts. Returns Markdown and HTML.

sectionItems.description: Ordered ELN sections to include. Library sections use source=library and an existing id. Custom sections use source=custom with a title.

inputSchema.description: Input contract for the Verbex ELN template builder endpoint.

experimentTitle.description: Title for the ELN entry template.

includeTimestamps.description: Whether to include record metadata fields.

includeVoicePrompts.description: Whether to include Verbex-style section voice prompts.

name: eln_template

card.description: What the Verbex card draws; same values as the notebook entry.

notebookEntry.description: Markdown entry to paste into a lab notebook.

title: Electronic lab notebook entry template
